nodes.label: The application icon
nodes.rationale: A steering wheel drawn as a flat outline in Catalyst red on a near-black rounded square: an outer ring, a hub, one spoke to twelve o'clock and two falling to about four and eight. Squared-off shoulders on the lower spokes give it the silhouette of a racing wheel rather than a car's. No text, no bolt mark — the icon does not reuse the wordmark's lightning glyph.

nodes.label: The steering wheel motif
nodes.rationale: The mark says driver station rather than robot: a wheel is what the human holds, which is the half of the system this product serves. Read against rule 1 it is a deliberate near-miss — the app is named for the driver's seat and iconified with a control the app itself explicitly refuses to be.

nodes.label: The Tauri icon set
nodes.rationale: One steering-wheel drawing rasterised at 32, 128, 256 and full size for the Windows installer, the taskbar and the shortcut. Consistent with the banner's palette — the same Catalyst red on the same near-black — but not with its glyph, since the banner leads with the bolt and the icon with the wheel.

hyperedges.label: One drawing rasterised at four sizes
